questions.caption: Every trip is an offer with conditions.
questions.description: The question changes. Dates, price basis and booking terms still need to be readable.

attributes.description: Keep the facts that define the offer together, from available dates to the terms of a change.

roadmap.label: Explore the travel pilot
roadmap.diagram: The information and handoff to review

stages.label: Agree scope
stages.title: One market. An agreed starting point.
stages.description: Confirm the language and data coverage before beginning. Start from the public pages and product data agreed with your team.
stages.note: A pilot begins with an agreed scope; this roadmap does not indicate a live booking integration.

stages.label: Review offers
stages.title: Read the offer before the booking flow.
stages.description: Review the information on pages you control and agreed product data. Your team verifies travel attributes; ecentic does not invent missing facts.

steps.title: Supported feed
steps.body: Use the defined importer field mapping.

steps.title: Offer facts
steps.body: Verify dates, prices, inclusions and terms.

stages.note: The baseline needs no booking-engine login, customer data or code on your site.

stages.label: Review handoff
stages.title: Keep the booking boundary explicit.
stages.description: Examine the agreed path from public information to a booking flow. Later access or integration work needs a separate scope.

steps.title: Public offer
steps.body: Keep dates, prices and terms clear.

steps.title: Channel or provider
steps.body: Booking behavior depends on the channel and flow.

steps.title: Booking handoff
steps.body: Review the agreed destination and next step.

stages.note: No automated booking integration is promised, and an assistant may link to a booking platform instead of your site.
